# Boiler Service

Serviced on 14 February by Hearth and Flue. Next service is due in February 2027.

## Pressure

The gauge should sit at 1.2 bar when the heating is cold. If it drops below 1 bar, top it up with the filling loop under the boiler: open both taps slowly until the needle reaches 1.2, then close them.

## Radiators

The bedroom radiator needed bleeding twice last winter. The bleed key is in the drawer under the kettle.
